status: AI-generated input revision; requires fresh reference-only controls and a new freeze before qualification
scope: Reference automated screening, not proof of visual indistinguishability; no human approval gate

calibration.prompt: A person in a blue jacket walks through a sunny park. Birds sing softly.

preprocessing.video: RGB24 decoded with ffmpeg; area resize to 320x240; original frame indices retained
preprocessing.audio: 32 kHz stereo PCM float; 24 Hz RMS envelopes, 1024-point Hann STFT hop 256
preprocessing.lpips: squeeze, version 0.1, CPU float32, RGB [-1,1]; every sampled frame
preprocessing.flow: Farneback on sampled grayscale frames, OpenCV fixed parameters
preprocessing.identity: YuNet 2026may CPU detections (score 0.8, NMS 0.3), largest reference face, candidate IoU >=0.5; SFace aligned embedding cosine and LPIPS at the reference crop. Coverage required; generated face consistency, not identification of real people.
preprocessing.av: stream timing plus relative speech-envelope/mouth-motion lag proxy when face-tagged; not speech-recognition or lip-sync ground truth
preprocessing.continuation: report suffix separately; apply the same spatial bounds in [-6,+12] frame seam window; inherited latent prefix must remain byte-identical

positive: RGB integer perturbation +/-1 with fixed seed; PCM quantization to 16-bit

hard_checks: no teacher forcing in independent trajectories
